newsitem.title: USA: Diablo Canyon nuclear unit at 90 pct and rising.
newsitem.headline: Diablo Canyon nuclear unit at 90 pct and rising.

text.p: The 1,073 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Diablo Canyon nuclear power plant had reached 90 percent power as of early Thursday and was expected to reach full power by 1200 PDT, Pacific Gas & Electric Co, the plant's operator said.
Overnight the unit was ramped down to 60 percent capacity for repairs to its condensate system.
The unit, which was shut last week because of problems with its feedwater system, had reached 75 percent early this week.
Diablo Canyon's 1,087 MW unit 1 was said to be operating normally.
